returns: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Returned items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
shipping: Standard shipping is free on orders over $35 and takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping costs $9.99 and takes 1-2 business days. ShopLite ships only within the United States.
promo: Only one promo code can be applied per order. Promo codes are case-insensitive. Expired codes cannot be applied. Promo codes cannot be used on gift cards.
warranty: Electronics come with a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.
account: Customers can reset their password from the sign-in page using 'Forgot password'. ShopLite support never asks for your password.
